summary: Read the corrected receipt (CheckRun 3dfdf5237f7b45989c7ca8bb6a448bb2): the previous stream-crossing defect is gone for comparison 2, which is now complete with the candidate StateLeader at term 3 witnessed in both streams (indices 17 and 25), alongside the accepted peer-form MsgForgetLeader in both streams (13 and 22) — so the disruption half of the finding is witnessed three times with the under-lease control holding each time. The three bound comparisons are still unknown, and the receipt's diagnostic again names the quorum stream's campaign event at index 11: the admission check scans admission events across the whole file while results exist only in the aftermath stream, so I recorded that as a wiring defect of mine (not target evidence) and left the aftermath observation uncited. The requested successor of the same fixed experiment renames the aftermath stream's events to a_* so each stream carries exactly one admission event per alias, keeping the same scenario and six comparisons; the harness passes locally and validation accepted the update with the execution requested. Incomplete: that renamed receipt is pending, and the bound half (deposed incumbent sheds leadership, anchor equals the committed prefix, no committed index lost at index 10) stays unmeasured.
